pages.title: Throwable Sacs
pages.text: Throwable sacs release contained mixtures on impact, applying effects to enemies, allies, or the environment.

pages.title: Purifying Sac
pages.text: Cleanses negative effects from affected entities, making it useful for recovery and support.

pages.title: Foul Sac
pages.text: Releases a harmful mixture that poisons and slows targets while dealing damage.

pages.title: Frost Sac
pages.text: Weakens and immobilizes targets caught in its impact.

pages.title: Searing Sac
pages.text: Applies burning and bleeding in an area, making it effective for aggressive engagements.
